entries.text: SQL Server 改用 SQLScriptParser，脚本解析入口统一
entries.textEn: SQL Server now uses SQLScriptParser; script parsing has a single entry point

entries.text: 修复外键定义解析、unqualify 与表提示语法的缺陷，并统一语法文件
entries.textEn: Fixed foreign-key definition parsing, unqualify and table-hint grammar, and consolidated the grammar files

entries.text: 新增 TDSQL 适配分支
entries.textEn: Added a TDSQL adaptation branch

entries.text: 支持 SQL Server 的局部与全局临时表关键字
entries.textEn: SQL Server: local and global temporary table keywords

entries.text: MySQL 的字符串常量可以使用双引号表示
entries.textEn: MySQL string literals may use double quotes

entries.text: 非 MySQL 数据库的字符串常量不支持反斜杠转义
entries.textEn: String literals do not support backslash escapes on non-MySQL databases

entries.text: SQL Server 的字符串常量不支持反斜杠转义
entries.textEn: SQL Server string literals do not support backslash escapes

entries.text: 支持 SQL Server 的别名赋值写法 select uid = col from t
entries.textEn: SQL Server: alias assignment select uid = col from t

entries.text: 新增 TSQL 解析器与 SQL 脚本访问器
entries.textEn: Added the TSQL parser and SQL script visitor

entries.text: SQL 解析入口改为 root
entries.textEn: The SQL parse entry point moved to root

entries.text: exists 不再作为标识符处理
entries.textEn: exists is no longer treated as an identifier

entries.text: 支持中文全角空白符
entries.textEn: Added Chinese full-width whitespace

entries.text: 修复达梦执行计划的索引使用解析缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed index-usage parsing in Dameng execution plans

entries.text: 修复 Position 函数解析与输出的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed Position function parsing and output

entries.text: 修复达梦与 Oracle explain 解析中的索引使用缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed index usage in explain parsing for Dameng and Oracle

entries.text: 修复子查询解关联算法缺陷（RulePredicatesSSQRewrite、RuleSelectSSQRewrite）
entries.textEn: Fixed the subquery decorrelation algorithm (RulePredicatesSSQRewrite, RuleSelectSSQRewrite)

entries.text: 支持多个结构不同的选择列标量子查询解关联
entries.textEn: Scalar subqueries with several differently shaped select columns can be decorrelated

entries.text: 标量子查询的谓词不再下推
entries.textEn: Predicates of scalar subqueries are no longer pushed down

entries.text: 过滤谓词下推排除同一查询块内的情况
entries.textEn: Filter-predicate pushdown excludes the same query block

entries.text: TableR011 在起始值为空时不再报违规
entries.textEn: TableR011 no longer reports a violation when the start value is empty

entries.text: 其余内部改动（5 条提交）
